My dear [Miss Barlee](../persons.html#108)
The [Bishop of Madagascar](../persons.html#2344) has sent me this sad history of devastation asking to have it made known in [the Net](../others.html#94), so I send it to you direct.[^1] It has wandered a little as I am making visits in Devonshire but I hope to be at home by the end of the month.

yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Evidently Ellen Barlee, writer, social worker and contributor to MPhad succeeded Anne Mackenzie as editor of the missionary journal The Net.

The first Anglican Bishop of Madagascar, the Rt.

Rev.

Robert Kestell Cornish (1824-1909), was consecrated in 1874.

His brother-in-law taught at Winchester College and was a friend of CMY\'s.
